name: Subway platform
desc: An underground waiting place where people stand near strangers and a train ends the conversation.
tags: underground station platform, tiled wall, yellow platform edge line, fluorescent strip lights, station benches, advertising posters, row of pillars, railway tracks in the trench, dark tunnel mouth, hanging platform sign
prose: an underground station platform with tiled walls under fluorescent strip lighting, benches and advertising posters between the pillars, a painted line at the platform edge and a dark tunnel mouth beyond the tracks
note: No sky, so the hour cannot come from the light - an empty platform reads as late night, a packed one as rush hour, and that is the only clock you have. The track trench and the tunnel mouth are what stop this looking like a tiled hallway; without them there is no railway in the shot at all. Watch the platform edge, the model likes to stand figures down on the rails.
